clause: forall t :: 0 <= t < |s| && s[t] == ')' ==> 2 * Closes(s, t) < t
expr: all((((not (I.s[t] == ')')) or (2 * (I.s)[:t].count(')') < t))) for t in range(0, (len(I.s))))

clause: forall t :: 0 <= t < |s| && s[t] != '(' ==> 2 * Opens(s, t) > t
expr: all((((not (I.s[t] != '(')) or (2 * (I.s)[:t].count('(') > t))) for t in range(0, (len(I.s))))
